full_prompt_en: A square painterly animal portrait depicts two dark ravens standing close together on a pale rough ledge before a weathered cream and gray background. The larger bird occupies the right foreground, its head near the upper center and thick black beak pointing toward the left. The smaller raven stands behind and to the left, its head lower and partly overlapped by the nearer bird. Both face the same direction, their round dark eyes and heavy beaks clearly defined against the light ground. Blue-gray highlights run through the throat feathers and shoulders, while the main bodies remain charcoal black. On the larger bird, layered wing feathers sweep down toward the lower right, each long segment separated by narrow dark lines and a few dusty brown highlights. The smaller bird's wings are more compact and shadowed. Thin dark legs descend to the pale ledge along the bottom, where soft gray marks suggest grit or uneven stone. The background is mottled rather than fully described: warm beige stains, cool gray patches, faint scratches, and translucent marks make it resemble old plaster or aged paper. The birds' forms are carefully observed, yet their edges soften in places where loose dry-brush textures meet the background. Light appears to come from above and slightly left, catching the crown, beaks, and upper wing planes while leaving underparts and overlapping feathers deep in shade. The restrained palette gains richness from blue-black, smoky gray, and a little warm brown without turning into flat monochrome. No readable text appears. The overall composition is compact and still, using the birds' parallel leftward gaze and overlapping silhouettes to create a quiet, watchful presence.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形绘画式动物肖像描绘两只深色乌鸦紧挨着站在浅色粗糙台面上，身后是旧化的奶油色与灰色背景。较大的一只占据右前方，头部靠近上方中央，厚重黑喙指向左侧。较小的乌鸦站在左后方，脑袋更低，也被前面的鸟部分遮住。两只都朝同一方向，圆圆的深眼睛与厚喙在浅底前清楚可见。蓝灰色高光流过喉羽与肩部，身体主体仍是炭黑。大鸟层叠的翼羽向右下扫去，长羽段由窄深线分开，还有几点灰棕色高光。小鸟的翅膀更紧凑，也更背阴。细深色腿落向下缘浅色台面，柔灰笔痕暗示砂砾或不平的石面。背景斑驳而非完整描绘：暖米色污痕、冷灰色块、淡刮线和半透明痕迹，使它像旧灰泥或老纸。鸟的形态经过仔细观察，但松散干笔肌理与背景相遇处，部分边缘逐渐变柔。光似乎从上方略偏左落下，触及头顶、鸟喙和翅膀上平面，下腹与重叠羽毛则留在深影里。克制的配色从蓝黑、烟灰和少量暖棕获得丰富变化，没有变成平板单色。画中没有可读文字。整体构图紧凑而静止，两只鸟平行地向左张望，相叠剪影带来安静而警觉的存在感。
style_prompt_en: The painterly style combines close natural observation with a weathered, lightly distressed ground. Deep blue-black masses are lifted by smoky gray and soft brown dry-brush marks, so darkness holds layered internal structure. Fine directional strokes pick out selected surfaces, while other edges fray into a mottled cream background. Large overlapping silhouettes create a compact focal cluster; broad pale space around them keeps that density legible. The light falls from above to one side, leaving thin highlights along upper planes and rich shadow in recesses. The background carries stains, scratches, and granular pigment without defining a full setting. The overall effect is restrained and tactile, balancing careful anatomical detail with loose atmospheric wear.
style_prompt_zh: 这种绘画风格把细致的自然观察与轻度磨旧的斑驳底面结合。深蓝黑色块被烟灰和柔棕色干笔抬亮，因此暗处仍有层叠的内部结构。细定向笔痕挑出选定表面，其他边缘则散入斑驳奶油色背景。大型相叠剪影形成紧凑焦点群，周围宽阔浅色空间让这种密度仍易辨认。光从侧上方落下，在上平面留下细高光，在凹处积成丰厚阴影。背景有污痕、刮线和颗粒颜料，却没有定义完整场所。整体效果克制而可触，让准确的形态细节与松散的大气旧化感相平衡。
theme_en: Two dark ravens standing together against weathered pale stone
theme_zh: 两只深色乌鸦并立在斑驳浅色石面前
name: Barbara Chichester
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
